title: Institutional and private-equity capital is taking or rotating ownership positions in businesses that hold blueberry genetics
observation: Three separate ownership events sit inside the observation window. Hortifrut's 2023 integrated report records PSP Investments of Canada with SJF Investment SpA holding 49.56 per cent following a December 2022 investment agreement. Costa Group was taken private in February 2024 by a consortium of Paine Schwartz Partners, Driscoll's and British Columbia Investment Management Corporation, and its registered entity changed from Limited to Pty Ltd on 3 June 2024. Cinven and Label Investments agreed to sell Planasa to the EW Group.
why_it_might_matter: Ownership changes alter disclosure. A delisted or privately held breeder publishes less, which degrades the evidence base the platform depends on, and can change licensing posture. The Costa transaction is also notable because a direct genetics competitor, Driscoll's, is inside the acquiring consortium.
what_would_confirm_it: Disclosed shareholding percentages for the Costa consortium members; a completion announcement for the Planasa sale; or observable changes in licensing or disclosure behaviour after each transaction.
what_would_falsify_it: Evidence that these are passive financial holdings with no effect on genetics strategy, licensing terms or public disclosure; or reversal of any of the transactions.
